backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable (a second run stops on its own md5 guard, 55000, nothing changed); to undo apply the rollback. Apply AFTER s84_inventory_20261017, s85_cleaner_count_20261018 and s85_pay_details_20261019 (inventory_undo_v1 is guarded on the s85 body). Decisions Lloyd 2026-10-15 (D-330): all staff roles may add item photos; Honey sees where to buy (shop name, place, map link) and never a price, phone or note; the 'test' purchase is deleted; categories are tidied (Cleaning to Cleaning Supplies; Utility / Cleaning / Bathroom to Bathroom & Utility; Guest Supplies to Toiletries) with one audit row per item; an automatic categoriser may sort Uncategorised items. WHAT CHANGES: two new tables (inventory_suppliers, inventory_item_suppliers) with no client grants; supplier_id on inventory_purchases and inventory_shopping_list; inventory_items.location (column grant to authenticated, unit_cost stays closed); three suppliers (SM, KCC, Robinsons) created from the purchases and linked; the one test purchase deleted (its values are in the rollback; the guard stops unless exactly one row matches and nothing points at it); the catalogue gains location, supplier {id,name,location} for every role and lastPrice and priceUp for finance only; inventory_item_update_v1 accepts location; inventory_undo_v1 also clears supplier_id on the reopened shopping row; R1 to R9 (signed in, each gates itself), R10 to R12 and the categoriser write (service_role only), the exact-match resolver and an internal price-jump helper (no grant). PRICE BASIS: inventory_purchases.unit_cost is now PHP per base unit and qty is base units on BOTH paths. apply_inventory_purchase (the Telegram OCR restock) used to store the receipt line's per-pack price and the pack count; it now stores qty = packs x units_per_purchase and unit_cost = pack price / units_per_purchase (the same as record_inventory_receipt_v1). It was also invoker rights with search_path public and executable by authenticated and service_role: it is now SECURITY DEFINER with an empty search_path and executable by service_role ONLY (the bot); the 6- and 8-argument signatures are dropped first so PostgREST sees one overload each. The guard proves no existing OCR row has units_per_purchase other than 1, so no stored price needs rewriting. STORAGE (override O1): only the photos bucket limits (1 MB, jpeg and webp); the anon policies are already deleted and the bucket is already private; the storage step is skipped where the storage schema is absent. inventory_purchases leaves the realtime publication; price_history_by_item loses its anon grant and its write grants. The migration stops (55000) unless the five live bodies are exactly the ones cut from (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped: catalogue 5a2625ae6aab612a0f9c054df904e9b7, receipt 8 args 8e024f7f97169ed122175a2095cb1822, apply 6 args d94fceb8b7d074b16fca508f81b81156, item update d359c1e34bccebcb1300f3a4bd5fb865, undo = the s85 body 06ba21967be72a96d9eb7d4ceb94976f). Rehearsal: see docs/s86/rehearsal-s86.log.
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL first (after the backup and the rehearsal), then the Edge Functions (upload-photo, inventory-report, telegram-expense, inventory-categorise), then the staff app. The Telegram bot calls apply_inventory_purchase by named arguments, so it keeps working with the new defaulted p_supplier_id; until telegram-expense is redeployed it simply links by exact name or alias. No new secret. Known limit: unit_cost is numeric(10,2), so a per-unit price that does not divide evenly is stored to the cent (100 for 12 becomes 8.33; its pack price then reads 99.96).

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores the s84 / s85 bodies and the 6- and 8-argument signatures, puts the test purchase back verbatim, reverses the category tidy by item id and drops the new tables and columns. DATA LOSS by design: every supplier, link, supplier_id and location written since the apply. Purchase rows written after the apply keep their per-base-unit price and base-unit qty. The anon storage policies are not recreated.

compatibility.evidence: Old readers: the catalogue only gains keys (location, supplier, lastPrice, priceUp). The OCR path changes the stored basis (qty and unit_cost per base unit), which is the point of the release; no existing row changes. Callers checked: telegram-expense (apply_inventory_purchase), staff app and admin (record_inventory_receipt_v1, get_inventory_catalogue_v1); telegram_apply_inventory_count_v1 and save_shopping_item_v1 only mention the old names in comments and messages and do not call them.
